title: octopus.mini-scientist.event.v1
description: Typed event envelope for every Mini Scientist run. Ordered, append-only, replayable. The event store itself never creates authority.

run_id.description: run-<UTC timestamp>-<8 hex from /dev/urandom>, generated fresh per run

seq.description: 0-based position within the run; gaps are invalid

payload.description: Type-specific, schema-validated per event type in TEST-GATES.yaml

evidence_refs.description: Absolute paths (and sha256 where applicable) of raw evidence backing this event

may_authorize.description: Always false. An event can never carry authority.

prev_hash.description: Hash of the previous event line in this run (null for seq 0)

hash.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of this event without the hash field
